system.description:
Using this powerful song, the Elven lord sends forth a call to his brothers and cousins—a call heard in the very dreams of those he seeks. Successes over the obstacle are added to the Elf’s base Circles exponent when seeking to contact great lords and rulers.

Obstacle: 10 minus Elf’s Perception

Actions: 160

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 145
